_comment: Illustrative example. Synthetic protocol and figures, used only to show the tree shape, the categories and the flags. Replace everything.
title: Example Lending Protocol (synthetic figures)
headline: key reaching 100% of protocol supply

tree.name: Internal contracts: the protocol's own code
tree.note: Contracts the protocol wrote and can fix, as distinct from the assets and feeds it merely calls

kids.name: Vault connector, entity-wide
kids.note: Every market routes through this contract, so it reaches all supply including the sub-floor remainder

kids.name: Governance Safe
kids.note: Threshold measured, not inferred: a single signature can replace the implementation with no delay

kids.name: Terminal key
kids.note: A single private key sits above every market through the connector's proxy admin, with no timelock at any hop

kids.name: Market governor, two markets
kids.ctrl: sets caps, fees and the oracle per market

kids.name: Interest rate model
kids.ctrl: immutable, admin_roles empty with discovery status ok
kids.note: Verified absence of admin control, which is a genuine strength and worth stating

tree.name: External assets and their own control planes
tree.note: The protocol can monitor these but cannot fix them

kids.name: USDC, denomination asset of two markets
kids.ctrl: 15 admins across 2 subcategories, real control set
kids.note: Not a leaf: the roles beneath it are the loss paths

kids.name: Blacklister role
kids.note: Can strand the protocol's entire balance with no exploit and no protocol involvement

kids.name: Master minter and its own owner
kids.ctrl: role holder, own owner one hop below

kids.name: WETH, collateral of one market
kids.ctrl: immutable, admin_roles empty with discovery status ok

kids.name: Wrapped BTC, collateral of one market
kids.note: Custody of the underlying BTC is an off-chain arrangement with the merchant and custodian network

kids.name: Role registry, not expanded
kids.note: Inbound admin degree marks this as a role registry rather than a control set, so it is recorded with its degree and left unexpanded. Expanding it would inject unrelated parties from other protocols into the closure

kids.name: USD price feed, shared by both USDC markets
kids.note: Pair inferred from the address: feed nodes carry no pair identification

kids.name: Collateral feeds, price authority not confirmed per market
kids.ctrl: candidates listed, not confirmed to a single feed on-chain
kids.note: Admins over the feed set as a whole are ranked below, which is sound; the per-market attribution is not confirmed

tree.name: Counterparties
tree.note: Not contracts, but the primary lender loss path

kids.name: Largest borrower, grouped by owner prefix across 6 sub-accounts
kids.note: Sub-accounts grouped before ranking: ungrouped, this concentration reads roughly 4x too low
